Title: Cross availability zones support for Azure Service Fabric clusters is now available

Body.Content:
Cross availability zones support for Azure Service Fabric clusters is now available to the public. This new functionality allows Azure Service Fabric customers to have increased reliability via cross availability zone support for Service Fabric clusters.

Learn more
